reception: The earliest citations to NetBlocks are substantive rather than incidental. Work on microservice communication builds on its staged approach to custom host network stacks, and the staged-programming and network-function literatures name it among the systems that generate specialized packet-processing code; within the group, follow-on work carries its layout abstractions to FPGA switches. The pattern, at small scale, is descent rather than mention: the works that cite it are the ones building on it.
